title: Six-week retrospective and career sprint notes
content:
Date: 2026-03-09

Purpose: quick personal retrospective on last 6 weeks + concrete asks for upcoming manager 1:1. Keep this loose — bullets are talking points not a script.

What I set out to do (6-week sprint):
- Ramp the new onboarding checklist for hiring managers (pilot with Eng infra team). Goal: reduce first-90-day ramp blockers by 20%.
- Create a short coaching rubric for IC->EM transition conversations.
- Reduce time-to-offer bottlenecks for P3 roles by clarifying approvals.
- Run 2 skip-level feedback sessions and synthesize themes.

Results / evidence:
- Onboarding checklist: pilot completed with 2 hires (Eng infra). Positive signal: new hires reported fewer unanswered setup questions in week 1 (informal survey). TODO: run 6-week survey (Jira PO-88).
- Coaching rubric: draft done, tested with one manager; they found the behavioral examples useful. Need to add leveling signals.
- Time-to-offer: identified AP process step that adds median 48h (re-approval). I flagged to recruiting (see POPS-112).
- Skip-level notes: consistent ask for clearer career pathways and more manager calibration sessions.

Self-assessment (short):
- Strengths: moves cross-functional work forward, translates manager feedback into templates, good at shipping quick pilots.
- Areas to improve: need better stakeholder follow-up cadence (I let some items linger on my Trello), metrics hygiene (ensure surveys have baselines).

Concrete ask list for next manager 1:1 (ranked):
1) Career leveling calibration: request 30m with you + 2 EMs to discuss the rubric and sample calibrations. Outcome: decision on signals to include and one pilot calibration meeting.
2) Headcount support: can I get a green light to request a .4 FTE TA timebox for 6 weeks to unblock P3 hiring? This will help reduce the 48h re-approval.
3) Compensation check: quick sanity check on my comp trajectory and when to bring up leveling for promotion cycle.
4) Time/priority: permission to deprioritize internal slide-deck for onboarding until checklist is iterated twice.

Talking points / scripts to bring up:
- "Short wins: pilot reduced week-1 setup questions. With 2 cycles we can have a repeatable package for Eng teams."
- "Calibration ask: I propose a single 30-minute panel to align on rubric signals; outcome will be a one-page cheat sheet for managers."
- "Hiring blocker: the re-approval loop is adding 48h — small TA support would likely drop time-to-offer by ~20% for P3 roles."

Notes / open questions to resolve:
- Should career rubric be a public Confluence page or gated behind manager access while we iterate? (Pros/cons listed inline.)
- How to measure "fewer unanswered setup questions" formally — quick survey vs. auto Slack check-in?
- Is there an existing budget line for TA fractional support or should I route to finance?

Quick list of wins to mention (1:1):
- Drafted coaching rubric and used it twice with positive feedback.
- Identified 1 process bottleneck in hiring approvals and opened POPS-112.
- Ran skip-levels and surfaced cross-team themes for Q2 planning.

Personal growth asks (non-admin):
- Mentorship: request 6 months of mentor time with Senior PM (Samir suggested Kara).
- Exposure: a seat in two product roadmap reviews to better understand trade-offs (helps design onboarding prioritization).

Action items (next 2 weeks):
- [ ] Schedule manager + 2 EM calibration (target: week of 03/16).
- [ ] Draft final onboarding checklist v0.2 incorporating pilot feedback (due 03/20).
- [ ] Create 6-week survey for new hires (PO-88) and wire it to onboarding flow.
- [ ] Confirm TA timebox feasibility with finance.

Misc notes / friction log (short):
- Slack thread cluttered when collecting skip-level feedback — consider a short Google Form next time.
- My Trello board has stale cards; set recurring 30-min weekly cleanup.

Last thought: keep asks very tangible in the 1:1. Manager is pragmatic — lead with specific outcomes and required decision (e.g., "Can I reserve .4 TA for 6 weeks?").

References and quick links: POPS-112 (hiring), PLAT-3421 (onboarding infra tickets), goal template (confluence).

End of notes.
